issues.title: Bidi and word fragmentation artifacts
issues.description: Message bubbles exhibit punctuation inversion and broken word spacing under RTL.
issues.evidence: Periods render at the start of lines (.the QA workspace, .please) alongside kerning splits.
issues.suggestion: Ensure chat message text containers isolate LTR content direction.
issues.triageNote: Real defect: the bubble did not isolate content direction, so English (LTR) prompts under RTL pages got trailing periods flipped to line start; fixed by adding dir="auto" to the bubble container. Also proactively fixed the demo canvas (bg-neutral-900 → +dark:bg-neutral-100) which inverted to a near-identical light surface behind the light bubble in dark theme (pattern source of the pair-013 page-level finding).
